# Using Init Containers to perform tasks before a pod is deployed {#nodes-containers-init}

You can use *init containers*, which are specialized containers that run before application containers and can contain utilities or setup scripts not present in an app image.

## Additional resources {#additional-resources_nodes-containers-init}

- [Init Containers (Kubernetes documentation)](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/init-containers/)
